Definition: a pile of rubbish (as contorted), i.e. a ruin
BiblicalUsage: The word is a pile of rubbish, a ruin, and Isaiah uses it once, of Damascus: it shall be taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heap is the end of every city that trusts in itself: Damascus was a great city, and God says it will be a pile of rubbish, and the ruin is the sermon.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
